title: taro-cepact-genomics: analysis code for 'Shared clones trace the exchange of taro across the Pacific in the world's largest in vitro collection'
description: R code that reproduces every figure, table and reported number of Restall et al., 'Shared clones trace the exchange of taro across the Pacific in the world's largest in vitro collection' (submitted), from the DArTseq genotypes of the taro (Colocasia esculenta) collection at the Centre for Pacific Crops and Trees (CePaCT). The input data are deposited separately on Zenodo.
